title: Zesty Smoky Australian Fregola Pilaf
description: A charred, cheese-pull, one-pot Australian dish featuring fregola, with a smoky flavor and a flexitarian-friendly twist, this pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the fregola and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the diced grilled zucchini and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with grated cheddar cheese.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
